options.text: This solution suppresses false-positive leak alarms for former employees. One deployment manages every company in your corporate group: each company's group tenants are derived automatically from the other rows. The deployment ships in plan-only mode — nothing is written until you enable apply. This template deploys the infrastructure; the function code package is published in a follow-up step (see the README).

elements.name: environment
elements.label: Environment
elements.toolTip: Platform is the production environment. Preprod is the staging platform for trials.

options.text: Enter YOUR OWN company in the first row, then one row for each other company in the corporate group. (Row order does not change the behavior — every company's former list receives the other rows' employees — it just keeps the form readable.) Tenant IDs is a comma-separated list of that company's OWN Entra tenant GUIDs. API key: that company's own platform API key. Actor email: an existing platform user of that company — the API records every add and remove under this user, so an address that does not belong to the company is rejected. A row without an actor email stays plan-only but is still previewed; a row without an API key shows as an error in the preview until the key is added.

constraints.validationMessage: Digits, letters, dash and underscore only.
One or more tenant GUIDs, comma-separated.
A valid email address, or leave empty for plan-only.

options.text: API keys entered here are stored as Function App application settings (encrypted at rest). For Key Vault-backed keys deploy with an empty key and set an api_key_setting reference afterwards — see the README.

elements.name: appRegChoice
elements.label: App Registration
elements.toolTip: The engine reads Entra users through a multi-tenant App Registration with User.Read.All + Directory.Read.All. Creating a new one needs the Application Administrator role; without it choose the existing-app option.

elements.name: existingClientId
elements.label: Existing App Registration client ID
elements.toolTip: After deployment, one extra step: an owner of this App Registration runs a single command (shown in the deployment's Outputs tab) to trust the new managed identity. With 'Create new automatically' this step does not exist.

elements.name: grantConsent
elements.label: Grant admin consent automatically (needs Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator)

options.text: Leave this off unless you hold one of those roles — a failed consent call fails the whole deployment. Consent is still required either way: grant it afterwards under Entra ID > App registrations > API permissions. The multi-tenant app must also be consented once in every sibling tenant listed in the grid; the deployment output includes the exact note for your setup.

elements.name: applyChanges
elements.label: Apply changes
elements.toolTip: On: keeps the former-employee lists in sync automatically. Off: plan-only trial — reads and previews, writes nothing. Safe by design: only entries this app created are ever managed.

elements.name: clientMode
elements.label: Client mode
elements.toolTip: Real: works against the live platform (normal use). Mock: a self-contained trial — nothing leaves Azure, data is kept in the app's own storage.

allowedValues.label: Mock (local trial, no live API calls)

elements.name: syncInterval
elements.label: Sync interval
elements.toolTip: How often the former sync reconciles each company.

elements.name: includeDeleted
elements.label: Include soft-deleted users (V2)
elements.toolTip: A user deleted from Entra ID stays recoverable for 30 days. On (recommended): those recently deleted users also count as former employees. Off: only disabled accounts count.
